newsitem.title: USA: Details of Reuter U.S. election day coverage plans.
newsitem.headline: Details of Reuter U.S. election day coverage plans.

text.p: The first results from Tuesday's U.S. elections are expected shortly after polls close at 6 P.M. EST (2300 GMT) in the states of Kentucky and Indiana.
Fuller results will come when another seven eastern states close their polls at 7 p.m. (Midnight GMT).

Television networks say they will project winners in the U.S. presidential and Congressional races based on exit polls and actual results once a majority of polling stations have closed in each state.
The first television network projection of the presidential election winner is unlikely to come before 9 p.m. (0200 GMT) and it could be much later if the race is close.
Projections of which party has won control of the Senate and House of Representatives could take many hours longer because of time differences in the West, where there are many key races.

Reuters will provide regular leads throughout November 5 and will issue bulletins and newsbreaks on significant results and on projections showing who has won the presidency, Senate and House of Representatives.
Urgent breaks will also be issued on the fate of key personalities like House of Representatives Speaker Newt Gingrich.
We will run comprehensive leads regularly through the evening and night and a separate running series on the congressional races. GLANCE summaries of our stories will be run for screen services.
Tables of results of the electoral college by state, all Senate races and the most competitive House of Representatives races will be issued regularly during the evening.
After the results of the elections are known we will run an extensive menu of profiles, analysis and predictions of the policies, make-up and course of the new administration.
